name: Hueglass
subtitle: A brass-and-glass colour lab
shortDescription: Five real dyes, one heavy glass tumbler and a pearl to match: 160 refractive 3D colour puzzles with a Daily Hue and a Lab Notebook.
longDescription:
Step into a small brass-and-slate colour atelier. Five dye bottles hang in the lamplight above a heavy glass tumbler: Rose, Amber, Aqua, Milk and Ink. Tip them in, watch the pigment swirl and settle, and bring the liquid to the exact shade of the pearl floating in its brass bezel.

### The Glass Is The Game
The tumbler is modelled in real 3D: thick refractive walls, soft studio reflections, a curved meniscus where the dye climbs the glass, and clouds of pigment that bloom as each stream lands. A brass coaster, cork-stoppered bottles and warm dust in the light make the bench feel like a place you could reach into.

### Colour That Behaves
Nothing here is a slider. Each dye absorbs light like a real pigment, so Rose with Amber warms to orange, Aqua with Amber turns green, Milk lifts a shade toward pastel and a few drops of Ink pull it toward shadow. How close you are is measured the way colour scientists do it, with the CIE94 colour-difference formula, so a perfect three-star pour has to be genuinely perfect.

### 160 Levels Across Eight Worlds
Begin at the Warm-up Bench with two dyes. Later worlds ration your stock, hand you a ruined batch to rescue, hide the target as a mystery hue you decode from written clues, and finish in the Grand Atelier. A solver has checked every level, so a winning mix always exists.

### Keep A Lab Notebook
Each new shade you invent is written down with its recipe and hex code: Emerald, Mocha, Lavender, Gunmetal and plenty more. Browse the discovery shelf, learn why a recipe works, and chase the ones you have not found yet.

### Daily Hue, Endless Blend, Free Pour
One fresh target every day with a streak to protect, an endless chain that keeps tightening the tolerance, and a free bench for pouring purely for fun. No timers, no lives, and everything runs without a connection.
